scope: All seventeen native PTY contracts pass against compiled Rust extensions. Native pane fixtures retain host-owned rendering and mount-time file identity rather than React closures. Trust state and shutdown logs are checked on disk in disposable directories. Full cell-buffer differential parity and non-Unix lifecycle verification remain separate release gates.
